title: #broadway #musicaltheatre #musicals #theatre #fyp
transcript: here's a list of musicals that I wan to see revivals of for mostly selfish reasons like does anyone want them other than me? I don't know, I don't care this is my list some have even been produced recently and I just didn't get to see them so like I said: selfish one of those shows is of course the Lord of the rings musical which like I am a huge fan of Lord of the rings I'm obsessed with this score and I've never gotten to see it there is a revival kicking around that played in the UK and Chicago and yes believe me, I looked into travelling but I couldn't make it work and now it seems like this other international [run of this same] production is having some difficulties so I don't know, I'm not holding my breath in a similar vein I'm also desperate to see the Secret Garden musical which did have a major run in LA recently that had Broadway ambitions that I think didn't pan out and this other UK revival was just announced unfortunately it's directed by my nemesis, John Doyle but I guess beggars can't be choose but as for shows that have not been revived as recently I'm gonna talk about three in one go first of all: passion a Funny Thing Happened on the way to the Forum and Do I Hear a Waltz now what do these three shows have in common? they are of course the only three Sondheim musicals that I have never personally seen performed live I even had the opportunity to see this 2013 revival of Passion starring Judy Kuhn but I skipped it and I sort of regret it though it was also directed by my nemesis John Doyle so maybe it was for the best next up I have two underrated Golden Age classics: first of all: Man of La Mancha which I've always loved but never seen live and the most Happy Fella by Frank Loesser who also wrote Guys and Dolls and How to Succeed but in my opinion this musical is operating on a whole other level than those two it's a lot more intricate and emotionally complex fun fact I actually played the lead in a youth production of The Most Happy Fella which is one of my favorite experiences I've ever had so it's very close to my heart but I've never been able to see it from the audience recently there was an experimental revised version by Daniel Fish, who did Sexy Oklahoma but it didn't seem to pan out next up Venice which played at the public in 2013 starring Leslie Odom Jr, Jennifer Damiano and more It’s a loose retelling of Shakespeare's Othello but with a pop / hip hop score I believe the show was not especially well liked overall but I am obsessed with the cast album and the last three shows on this list have a common theme which is that they are all lesser-knownadaptations of popular work starting off with Maury Yeston’s version of Phantom of the opera which was unfortunately eclipsed by Andrew Lloyd Webber's version then there's the Peter Pan musical adaptation by Stiles & Drewe which I actually prefer to the much more famous musical adaptation that of course starred Mary Martin, Cathy Rigby etc and finally the Kander & Ebb musical adaptation of The Skin of Our Teeth which had a few out of town runs one of which featured the legendary Eartha Kitt but it never played in New York and the score only exists in bootlegs and demos but I think it's excellent funny enough we're about to get a different musical adaptation of The Skin of Our Teeth next month which I am actually very excited for it's one of my most anticipated shows of the season but at the same time I feel like the universe is teasing me a little bit so that's my list but what about you? what are the shows that you most want to see revived even if nobody else cares?
